# Shreyash Tripathi

> Frontend Developer & UI/UX Engineer based in Noida, India. Builds production UI with React, Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript, and contributes to AI-integrated SaaS platforms and marketing sites at a digital product agency. Open to interesting freelance projects and collaborations.

## Summary

Shreyash Tripathi is a frontend-focused full-stack developer and UI/UX contributor with production experience shipping features on AI-integrated SaaS platforms and marketing sites at a digital product agency. He builds UI across React, Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript codebases using Tailwind CSS, Supabase and REST APIs, and is comfortable owning components end-to-end — from responsive layout and design-system consistency through backend integration. He is currently a Junior Developer, UI/UX at Garage Collective, promoted from an AI Trainee role.

## Experience

- Junior Developer, UI/UX — Garage Collective, Noida (Feb 2026 – present), promoted from AI Trainee. Ships production UI and AI-powered features across the agency's client and SaaS portfolio: analytics dashboard integrations, a 45-page school marketing site rebuild, a zero-knowledge credential management tool, a daily AI content-generation agent (~40% less manual effort), UTM auto-tagging and partner-portal tooling for a multi-tenant affiliate-marketing SaaS platform, UI theming and responsiveness work on an AI call-screening product's marketing site, dark-mode fixes on a social-listening platform, and UI/build fixes on a startup-investor marketplace and an SEO/AI-visibility platform. Broader stack exposure spans Three.js, GSAP, Framer Motion, Stripe/Razorpay, Clerk and Turborepo.
